messages:
maria: Heads-up: partner team requested a 90d SIEM export for an external forensic vendor. They asked for raw logs. We need to enforce scrubbing + KMS unwrap controls. What's the minimal, auditable handoff we can give?
aj: We should avoid handing over raw. Proposal: scrubbed snapshot + JIT KMS unwrap via our proxy, and timebox the download URL.
kevin: +1. For external vendors, prefer 7d TTL on the presigned link unless contract explicitly permits longer. If vendor must keep 90d, they should store encrypted and we hold the unwrap key.
denise: Also require a ticket with justification and an RBAC grant (temp role) that records who requested and who approved. Legal should approve vendor handling for 90d. @legal
maria: Vendor is a SOC-run provider for a regulator audit. They claim they need 90d to re-run detections, but we should still minimize PII. Can we list exact fields to strip?
aj: Minimal process outline: 1) Build scrubbed snapshot (fields removed), 2) Encrypt with export CMK (alias/redwood-export-key), 3) Upload to export bucket with object ACL restricted, 4) Generate ephemeral presigned URL via proxy with audit log. If vendor insists on holding copy, require escrow encryption (we rotate) and require SLA for storage & deletion.
kevin: Who authorizes unwrap? We need a 2-person approval: Security + Legal or Security + SOC owner. That should map to a policy in the KMS proxy service.
sam: For data minimization, start with removing: ip_address, user_id, email, device_id, session_token, exact_location. Keep timestamps, event_type, and aggregated counts for context.
aj: Snippet for generating a scrubbed snapshot (example):
```
# generate scrubbed snapshot
python tools/snapshot.py --from 2024-11-01 --to 2025-02-01 \ 
  --remove-fields ip_address user_id email device_id session_token \ 
  --out /tmp/snap.gz
aws s3 cp /tmp/snap.gz s3://redwood-siem-exports/job-98321/ \ 
  --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id alias/redwood-export-key
```
kevin: Also add an audit record schema: performer, approver, reason, allowed_ttl_days, object_key, job_id. That needs to be immutable in our audit log.
ops-bot: Snapshot job queued: job-98321 (eta ~15m) :gear:
maria: For the 90d ask: vendor wants to retain for 90d on their side. Two options: A) we give 7d presigned link and they must request replays from us (we re-run exports to their requests), or B) they hold the envelope but we retain unwrap control and require contractual decrypt restrictions + on-demand unwrap by us. B requires legal sign-off.
denise: I'll draft the handoff template and approval checklist. Would anyone volunteer to co-own the RBAC matrix we need for the temporary role?
aj: I can take the RBAC matrix. I'll propose role: export_viewer_temp with proto timebox and KMS Unwrap flag disabled. KMS unwrap should be routed via proxy workflow and require explicit approval.
kevin: Make sure the proxy emits a signed audit event with CMK id and approver. Also include an S3 lifecycle rule to delete raw snapshot after X days (X = ttl we agree).
maria: Action items: denise draft template by EOD tomorrow; aj build RBAC matrix + policy PR by Thursday; kevin add audit event schema and S3 lifecycle rule; legal to confirm vendor contract clause. If legal approves 90d retention on vendor side, we reconvene.
denise: noted. will ping @legal and post draft here when ready.
maria: Thanks everyone. For now, block any direct raw log exports; only approve via this scrubbed-snapshot + proxy flow. :lock:
